paragraphs: Optimising real‑time ad auctions demands models that can adapt instantly; my recent work on a multi‑omics cancer platform shows I can build agents that resolve complex queries on the fly.
I built a tool‑calling LLM agent using LangChain, AWS Bedrock and Claude Haiku 4.5, adding three specialised tools for gene alias resolution, scoring‑methodology explanation and dataset provenance.
I also engineered scikit‑learn pipelines and LSTM/BiRNN/CNN models in TensorFlow/Keras, deploying them as FastAPI services in Docker.
Could we arrange a brief call so I can walk you through how these techniques could translate to Quantcast’s real‑time optimisation challenges?
